spec_text_or_path: chr-mechanist-turret-drone: machine-core proxy identity — player deploys Stinger turrets + drone network (Laser/Rocketeer/Poison/Holy Lance variants); no player direct-damage primary loop; placed-proxy-count geometry (multiple simultaneous machines) and per-machine behavior differentiation not addressable in current engine; Ammo resource deploys machines that persist independently

chr-pet-warden: companion-core identity — 7 pet types (wolf/Alpha Wolf, wisp, spiderling, demon, imp, eye, sandworm) cover combat zone; companions do most damage; per-pet behavior differentiation (Wolftooth bleed stacking, Wolfcaster Ice Shard link, Thumper Sandworm rune) not addressable; companion-count and individual behavior spec required

chr-thorns-templar: Retaliator set formula converts stats to Thorns — '50% of damage stat in additional thorns + 30% of maximum health in additional thorns' (Nemesis shield adds health-to-Thorns conversion); health and damage stat are directly the damage substrate for the reflect; engine has no formula for multi-stat thorns derivation
